title: Boridain Glacierbane escort (Coldain ring2)
summary: Protect Boridain on his hunt and defeat the rabid kodiak at the end.
overview: Protect Boridain on his hunt and defeat the rabid kodiak at the end.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The quest hand-in starts Boridain's route.
Stay with him through his food and rest stops.
At the final stop, defeat the rabid tundra kodiak and return the requested proof to Boridain.
